standard.title: Specification for Towing Hook for Use Between Trailers of Up to 5 Tonnes Gross Mass and Transport Tractor
standard.sector: Transport Engineering / Transport Tractors and Trailers

sectional_committee.name: Transport Tractors and Trailers Sectional Committee

standard.description: This standard specifies the material, design, dimensions, and marking requirements for towing hooks utilized for coupling transport tractors and trailers where the gross mass of the towed trailer or laden train of multiple trailers does not exceed 5 tonnes gross mass.
standard.scope: This standard specifies the material, design, dimensions, and marking requirements for towing hooks utilized for coupling transport tractors and trailers where the gross mass of the towed trailer or laden train of multiple trailers does not exceed 5 tonnes gross mass.

certification.description: Voluntary Quality and Performance Specification. Certification under the BIS ISI Mark Scheme is voluntary for this standard. However, compliance with IS 8752:1978 is universally mandated by Regional Transport Offices (RTOs), vehicle type-approval laboratories (such as ARAI, GARC, and ICAT) under Rule 120 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR), 1989, and public logistics contracts to guarantee coupling safety, ensure roadworthiness of laden trains, and prevent tractor-trailer decoupling. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable.
requirements: Every certified towing hook conforming to this standard may be legibly marked with the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) along with the manufacturer's registered licence number (CM/L) on the body.

Towing hooks must be either forged or cast. Forged hooks must be manufactured from Grade C30 carbon steel per IS 1875-1971 in a normalized heat-treatment condition. Cast hooks must be manufactured from Grade 2 1.5% manganese steel castings per IS 2708-1973.
The towing hook is strictly restricted to light haulage applications. The gross laden train mass (including single or multiple towed trailers) must not exceed 5 tonnes.

An efficient safety catch must be provided as shown in Fig. 1. The safety catch must lock automatically or be manually secured to prevent accidental detachment of the trailer drawbar eye from the hook during dynamic field movements.

Each towing hook must be legibly and permanently marked at an appropriate place with: a) 'TO TOW 5 TONNES GROSS' on one side of the body; and b) 'IS : 8752' on the opposite side to designate its maximum capacity and standard conformity.
All coupling jaw openings, hook curvatures, and shank dimensions must conform strictly to Fig. 1 to ensure standard clearance and seamless matching with drawbar eyes.
